title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated September 30, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $10,150.00
text:
[3. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated September 30, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $10,150.00
  to fund Pacific Community Police Station renovations, as set forth.  [BPC #26-322]

  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s report.
summary: The Board is asked to approve a $10,150 donation to fund renovations at the Pacific Community Police Station.
